name: io.github.hail-hq/hail-mcp
title: Hail
description: Run your AI assistant with real phone numbers and email inboxes. Handle calls, texts, and email.

tools.name: place_call
tools.description:
Start an outbound AI phone call.

        With ``from_`` omitted, Hail uses the oldest active workspace number with
        voice capability, or a shared pool number when none is available.
        A dedicated number is not required. Shared pool numbers cannot be selected
        explicitly; an exhausted pool returns an ``error`` result without starting a call.
        The call uses instructions from ``system_prompt`` or a saved ``agent_id``,
        or a model endpoint supplied in ``llm``. At least one is required.
        US artificial-voice calls (47 CFR 64.1200(b)(1)) require the AI disclosure.
        Hail does not verify the lawful basis or the recipient's consent.
        A 4xx response returns no ``idempotency_key``.

        Returns the call ID, status, phone numbers and ``idempotency_key``, or an error.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description:
Send an email from a verified workspace sender.

        Plain-text emails still have sending, delivery and bounce events.

        Without ``from_``, one verified custom domain takes priority over the Hail mail address.
        Several verified custom domains require an explicit ``from_`` address.
        A custom domain blocked from sending (``sends_enabled`` false, PATCH ``/v1/email-domains/{id}``) is skipped for picks and refuses an explicit ``from_``.
        When configured, a workspace without a sender receives a Hail mail address automatically.

        Hail does not verify consent.

        Returns the email ID, status, sender, recipients and ``idempotency_key``, or an error.

tools.name: upload_email_attachment
tools.description:
Upload a small attachment for outbound email, as base64 text.

        Meant for small files (under about 50 KB): every base64 character goes
        through the tool call itself. Larger files go through ``create_file_upload``
        with ``purpose="email_attachment"``: its ``curl`` line sends the bytes, and its
        ``id`` works in ``send_email``'s ``attachment_ids``.
        Returns ``id``, ``filename``, ``content_type`` and ``size_bytes``.
        The ID is accepted in an email's ``attachment_ids`` and is reusable across sends.
        Unused uploads expire after 24 hours.
        The combined message and attachments must fit the 25 MB sending limit.

filename.description: File name shown to recipients, such as ``invoice.pdf``.
filename.title: Filename

content_type.description: The file's MIME type, such as ``application/pdf``.
content_type.title: Content Type

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

tools.name: create_file_upload
tools.description:
Create a one-time link that uploads one file from a shell with curl.

        The bytes go from the local disk to Hail directly, not through the tool call,
        so any file that is not tiny goes this way.
        An email attachment can be up to 25 MB. A verification document must be
        JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 10 MB, and is usable for 1 hour after the upload.
        SMS evidence must be a JPG, PNG or PDF of the given ``content_type``, up to 10 MB.
        Its upload response has a public ``url`` for an ``*_evidence_url`` field.
        Carrier reviewers open it without signing in, so remove personal information first.
        Returns ``id``, ``upload_url``, ``expires_at`` (15 minutes), ``max_bytes``
        and a ready ``curl`` line with a ``'FILE_PATH'`` placeholder for the
        file's absolute path.
        The link needs no key and works once. The upload response holds
        ``size_bytes`` and ``sha256`` to compare with the local file.

purpose.description: What the file is for. ``email_attachment``: its ``id`` goes in ``send_email``'s ``attachment_ids``. ``verification_document``: its ``id`` goes in the ``files`` of ``check_verification`` and ``submit_verification`` as ``{slot, upload_id}``. ``sms_evidence``: a US texting consent screenshot; the upload response's ``url`` goes in an ``*_evidence_url`` field. Anyone with that link can open the file, and a workspace keeps at most 100. Deleting one needs the console or ``DELETE /v1/verifications/sms/evidence/{organization_id}/{token}``.
purpose.title: Purpose

content_type.description: The file's MIME type, such as ``application/pdf``.
content_type.title: Content Type

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description:
Send an outbound text message.

        Without ``from_``, supported destinations use the workspace's alphanumeric sender ID.
        Other destinations use an eligible workspace SMS-capable number.
        A missing required number returns 422. SMS does not use the shared voice-call pool.
        US long-code texting to US recipients requires ready A2P 10DLC registration and an attached number.
        Trial texts (only to the workspace's own verified phone, set up in the console: Overview > Test a text): without from_, Hail uses one when the workspace's own number cannot text that US phone; set from_ to the trial number to use one directly. Each starts with "[Hail trial]".

        The message purpose determines the consent checks. Marketing requires a consent source.
        Hail does not independently verify the recipient's consent.

        The result includes the delivery status and retry key. A failed carrier attempt can
        appear as a message record with status ``failed``.

tools.name: create_agent
tools.description:
Save an agent for calls, texts, and email replies.

        The saved instructions and enabled channels apply when a number or email address
        routes to this agent. Saving the agent does not change existing routing.
        The call agent can hand over to listed contacts without seeing their phone numbers.

        Without a voice override, the built-in providers use the deployment's
        configured voice. A workspace provider uses its configured voice or its
        own default. An omitted language uses the speech providers' defaults (English).
        Without a tool list, the workspace's channels determine the available tools.
        The workspace call limit applies unless overridden, and the handover limit
        defaults to 30 minutes from the contact answering.

tools.name: route_number
tools.description:
Set the saved agents that answer a number's calls and texts.

        Replaces the selected routing settings. Registering or unregistering inbound

        Omitted settings retain their current values. A connected number
        (``source`` ``connected``) in state ``unverified`` returns an error
        until its ownership check succeeds in the console or the API.
        Returns the updated number record or an error.

tools.name: quote_numbers
tools.description:
Compare available phone numbers and their prices without buying or charging.

        Returns ``offers``, ``recommended_quote_id`` and ``expires_at``.
        Each offer includes ``e164``, ``number_type``, ``capabilities``, ``quote_id``,
        ``monthly_cents``, ``setup_cents``, ``readiness``, ``requirements``,
        ``subject_types``, ``verifications``, ``locality`` and ``region``.
        Prices are USD cents. ``locality`` and ``region`` tell apart cities with the same name.
        Quotes expire after ten minutes. Expired quotes cannot authorize a purchase.
        ``recommended_quote_id`` identifies a ready offer or is null when none is ready.

        ``subject_types`` identifies eligible personal or business registrations.
        ``verifications`` contains accepted registrations, with approved entries first.
        Entries include ``id``, ``state``, ``subject_type`` and ``subject_name``.
        ``readiness="verification_required"`` means registration approval is still needed.
        Registration requirements are specific to the quote and applicant type.
        An offer with ``by_request=true`` has no assigned number and requires a manual support order.
        Such offers remain valid for registration but are unavailable for automatic purchase.
        An upstream failure returns an error.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as ``US``.
country_code.title: Country Code

capabilities.description: Channels each offer must support. Omitting the filter searches for numbers that support both calls and texts.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

number_type.description: Offer only this kind of number, for example ``toll_free`` for a number callers reach for free. Omitted: every kind.
number_type.title: Number Type

area_code.description: First digits of the number as dialed inside the country, such as ``415``. Omitted: any digits.
area_code.title: Area Code

city.description: City name as carriers list it, such as ``Austin``. Omitted: any city.
city.title: City

region.description: US state or Canadian province code from ``list_number_regions``, to tell apart cities with the same name. Omitted: any region.
region.title: Region

tools.name: acquire_number
tools.description:
Buy a quoted phone number with explicit price confirmation.

        This charges the setup fee and first month immediately, then renews monthly.
        The purchase requires the user's authorization for that number and cost.
        Expired or changed offers return 409 without authorizing a different price.
        Each quote can buy at most one number.

        A retry with the same quote and ``idempotency_key`` refers to the original purchase.
        After a timeout, a new quote starts a different purchase and can buy a second number.
        A returned retry key is available after a timeout or server error.
        A 4xx failure returns no retry key; that failed request cannot be reused.
        A rejected or ambiguous registration selection returns 422.
        A purchase does not assign an answering agent automatically.
        Returns the number record and ``idempotency_key``, or an error with any available retry key.

        ``create_file_upload`` (purpose ``sms_evidence``) and use the ``url`` it returns.
        Document slots with ``needs_input=false`` require no upload.
        An upstream failure returns an error.

        the setup fee plus first month. Hail reserves that amount during review and

        owned ``number_id`` and ``registration_kind=toll_free`` among the form fields.

        to their size. Decoded inline files total at most 29 MiB. The API also
        limits the combined file size, including uploads, to 30 MiB.
        The form accepts at most 100 applicant answers. ``check_verification``
        can preflight the same form without filing.

        state, rejection details, timestamps, confirmation method and SMS progress fields.
        States are awaiting_review, submitting, submitted, approved, rejected or cancelled.
        SMS steps include confirm_identity, filing, carrier_review, needs_information and runtime_setup.
        ``campaign_accepted`` alone does not authorize texting: runtime readiness and number attachment are also required.

        ``waiting_for_credit`` means a carrier fee prevents the next step.
        ``credit_needed_cents`` is that registration's share of the additional credit needed,

        ``confirmation="code"`` identifies a carrier-texted confirmation code.

voice_id.description: Text-to-speech voice ID from the voice provider that serves the call, such as an ElevenLabs voice ID.
voice_id.title: Voice Id

tools.description: Names of the tools the agent may use during a call or reply. Omitted: every tool the workspace's channels support. An empty list: none, except that a call keeps the tools every call needs (end_call, send_dtmf and Hail's settings guide). HTTP tools stay on. Hail adds call transfer when handover contacts are configured.
tools.title: Tools

max_duration_seconds.description: Longest a call with this agent may last, in seconds, counted from pickup. At the limit the agent says goodbye and hangs up.
max_duration_seconds.title: Max Duration Seconds

handover_max_duration_seconds.description: Longest a call may last after a handover contact answers, in seconds, counted from that answer.
handover_max_duration_seconds.title: Handover Max Duration Seconds

voice_enabled.description: Whether this agent answers calls on numbers whose calls route to it.
voice_enabled.title: Voice Enabled

sms_enabled.description: Whether this agent answers texts on numbers whose texts route to it.
sms_enabled.title: Sms Enabled

email_enabled.description: Whether this agent replies to mail on addresses routed to it.
email_enabled.title: Email Enabled

status.description: ``paused`` stops the agent answering; ``live`` turns it back on.
status.title: Status

handover_contacts.description: Replaces the whole handover list; an empty list removes it. Up to ten ``{contact_id, note}`` entries, with ``contact_id`` from ``list_contacts``, ``lookup_contact`` or ``create_contact`` and a ``note`` of 1 to 200 characters.
handover_contacts.title: Handover Contacts

http_tools.description: Up to ten customer APIs the agent may call during calls, texts and email. Each entry: ``name`` (letters, digits, _), ``description`` (read by the model), ``url`` (public https), optional ``parameters`` (JSON Schema, type object), ``headers`` (static, stored encrypted, returned as names only), ``timeout_seconds`` (1 to 10, default 5) and ``wait_message`` (said on a call while waiting). The list replaces the saved one; an empty list removes it. On update, an entry without ``headers`` keeps the saved headers of the same name while the url keeps its host; a url on a new host needs ``headers`` again. The first save returns ``http_tool_secret`` once; requests carry ``X-Hail-Signature`` signed with it.
http_tools.title: Http Tools

clear_fields.description: Settings to reset to the workspace default. Omitted: nothing is reset.
clear_fields.title: Clear Fields

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.description:
Permanently delete a saved agent after explicit user authorization.

        A mismatched ``confirm_name`` returns an error without deleting anything.
        Numbers assigned to the deleted agent stop answering calls with it;
        texts are delivered to webhooks only.
        Pausing an agent is a separate non-deleting status change.
        Returns ``deleted``, ``agent_id`` and ``name``, or an error.

confirm_name.description: The agent's saved ``name``, as a safety check.
confirm_name.title: Confirm Name

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description:
List workspace members and manually saved contacts.

        A member entry carries a workspace role and a ``member:<user_id>`` ID.
        A manually saved contact has its own contact ID and no workspace role.
        Either kind can be selected for handover when it has a phone number.

q.description: Only contacts whose name, email or phone contains this text.
q.title: Q

limit.description: Maximum matching contacts to include in this reply. Omitted: 100.
limit.title: Limit

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

tools.name: lookup_contact
tools.description:
Find workspace contacts by name, email or phone fragment.

        Returns up to ten matches containing names, phone numbers, email addresses and IDs.
        Several matches can refer to different people.

query.description: Part of a name, email address or phone number, such as ``Dana``.
query.title: Query

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

tools.name: list_email_domains
tools.description:
List the workspace's sending identities and default sender address.

        The listing helps select a sender for ``send_email``.
        Only identities with ``verification_status="verified"`` can send.
        For ``kind="custom"``, ``domain`` is a domain supporting any local part.
        For ``kind="hail_mail"``, it is already a complete email address.
        One verified custom domain takes priority over the Hail mail address.
        With several verified custom domains, ``default_from`` is null and email sending requires an explicit sender.
        A custom domain with ``sends_enabled`` false cannot send: it is skipped for picks and refuses an explicit ``from_``.
        Toggle it with PATCH ``/v1/email-domains/{id}`` (custom domains only).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the ``next_cursor`` from the previous page. Omitted: the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: Maximum sending identities to include on this page. Omitted: 50.
limit.title: Limit

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description:
Identify the account and organization authorized by the current credentials.

        Returns ``auth_kind``, ``organization_id``, ``user_id``, ``email`` and ``name``.
        Shared operator credentials have ``auth_kind="shared"`` with null user details.
        The response identifies the current actor, not a message recipient.

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description:
Save a manually managed contact for calls, texts or email.

        The contact appears in workspace contact searches and can be selected
        for call handover if it has a phone number, or an extension on a call
        to a connected number. A duplicate phone or email returns 409.

phone_e164.description: Number used to call or text the contact. A contact can be reachable by phone, email, or both.
phone_e164.title: Phone E164

email.description: The address to email this contact at, such as ``ana@example.com``. Give this, ``phone_e164``, ``extension``, or several.
email.title: Email

extension.description: Extension on the workspace's connected phone system (1 to 6 digits, * or #), such as ``800`` for a support queue. Used for handover on calls to a connected number.
extension.title: Extension

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.
